purpose: Keep the public narrative, implementation and evidence boundary aligned during the queryable-memory and bounded-learning migration.
central_claim: Founder Chief of Staff turns a general AI agent into a durable operating partner by recovering bounded authoritative context, carrying work forward and applying previous failures as task-time controls.
required_distinctions: A context window is not operating memory.
A failure log is not learning.
Canonical sources remain authoritative; SQLite is a derived index.
Structural, synthetic and live evidence must remain distinct.

shipped_claims.claim: The release registers canonical sources, authority and explicit relationships.
The release builds a local derived SQLite full-text index and bounded context bundles.
The release selects task-applicable controls and evaluates candidate output.
The release records typed learning outcomes without self-modifying policy.
The release has deterministic synthetic evaluation for retrieval, context budget, control selection and candidate enforcement.

prohibited_overclaims: General live reliability has been proven.
The system autonomously rewrites and improves its own policy.
The release includes vector retrieval or a graph database.
The release includes Gmail or Calendar ingestion.
The derived SQLite index is a canonical source of truth.
release_rule: No public release until every gate in docs/EVALS.md passes and the versioned evaluation report records the final evidence and any remediation.
